parameters.content:
## Expense Capture (local demo)

1. Allowlisted user sends a **photo/image file** (no /start caption needed)
2. OpenRouter (`google/gemini-2.5-flash`) extracts fields
3. Row appended to Sheet with `pending approval`
4. **Inline Approve/Reject buttons** in Telegram (no browser redirect)
5. Pending Cards v2 sent to the configured Google Chat **1:1 DM** (Approve/Reject are **openLink** buttons)
6. Link click updates Sheet; Telegram buttons cleared + Chat card updated

Set `Chat DM Config` → `spaceId` to the 1:1 DM resource (`spaces/...`) locally before activating. Do not use a group space. Optional local env convention: `EXPENSE_CHAT_DM_SPACE_ID` / `GOOGLE_CHAT_DM_SPACE_ID`.

`/start` → help text.

Credentials: Telegram Expense Capture · OpenRouter Expense N8N · Google Sheets account · Google Chat Expense Capture

parameters.text:
Just send a receipt photo or image file (PNG/JPG) — no caption needed.

I will extract the details, add a Sheet row as pending approval, and show Approve/Reject buttons here in Telegram.

/start only shows this help message.
I only process receipt images. Send a photo or image file (PNG/JPG) with no special caption.
